change.previous_behavior: The measured pressure margin was used for recharge restart thresholds; dispatch selection kept the 1.0 MPa reference margin.
change.current_behavior: When explicitly enabled, the measured station-boundary margin is used for cascade dispatch selection and recharge restart selection.

claim_boundary: This is an opt-in station-boundary control calibration. It reduces dispatch/recharge chatter around the observed pressure noise band; it does not validate vehicle-side pressure, temperature, mass flow, protocol conformance, accident frequency or consequence distance.
